meaning:
μισθόω, -ῶ
(μισθός) [in LXX (mid.) chiefly for שָׂכָר ;]
to let out for hire. Mid., to hire: with accusative, Mat.20:1, 7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.
